rules.statement: Don't report that a project edit to a file the review rules list as template-owned will be overwritten by the next template update when `.copier-answers.yml` names that file under `project_owned_files`.
rules.why: A file named in `project_owned_files` is the repository's own. A template update leaves it alone and only shows the template's changes to it, so the project's edits stay.
rules.check: Before raising a template-ownership finding, check whether `.copier-answers.yml` lists the file under `project_owned_files` and whether AGENTS.md records the file as project-owned.

rules.statement: When a decision record overrides a rule from the project template, add it to the list of override records in AGENTS.md, and update that list's count to match.
rules.why: Readers check that list to find overrides, so a record left out of it hides the override.
rules.check: For any ADR or AGENTS.md text that says it overrides a template rule, confirm the ADR appears in AGENTS.md's list of override records and that the list's count is correct.

rules.statement: Wrap prose lines in decision records at 120 columns, and rewrap edited lines so no line runs past that width.
rules.why: The records wrap at 120 columns, so a longer line breaks consistency and will be flagged by a wrap check or a later reflow.
rules.check: Look for added or edited lines in docs/decisions Markdown files that are longer than 120 characters.
